race.description: Three Rivers Machinery Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: MELDIRER (6) was well in the betting here on debut and wasn't beaten too far away. Will have taken a lot from that experience and where there's smoke there's fire. Looms as the one they all have to run down. AZUCAR (4) finished fifth after being prominent at the turn at his most recent outing over 1180m at Gundagai. Looks to be in the right race to play a big role. COOLY ROCKS (8) returned from a spell two weeks ago when she was beaten 5.5 lengths into ninth over 1000m at Dubbo. Fitter this time will prove harder to beat. SILVER DREAM (12) gets in on the minimum and may run a race while fresh.
